· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low not met, Lower High not met) — sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.32x) — movement is supported by volume, increasing confidence.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) — maintaining wait-and-see with buy score of 4; consider buying upon RSI exiting oversold and MACD improvement.
